title: SMTP: AUTH command not implemented (submission port non-conformant)
description: smtp/session.rs: AUTH command not in the match statement. Clients on port 587 attempting AUTH receive 500 (command unrecognized). RFC 5321 submission requires AUTH. Fix: implement AUTH PLAIN and AUTH LOGIN, gated on TLS being active; advertise AUTH in EHLO only after STARTTLS upgrade. Since STARTTLS is not yet implemented, document this gap and the dependency.
notes: Implementation tracked in stoa-31947539.6 (deferred on STARTTLS)
